run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T01:36:10Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend error signal that opened this investigation is real and localized: frontend error spans rose from 0 (points at 01:11-01:35) to 1.359/s at 01:37, peaked at 3.61/s at 01:43 and were still 1.65/s at 01:47 while its total span rate held at roughly 39-46 spans/s. The failing operations are the frontend's own gRPC client calls to otel-demo AdService (grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds) plus the /api/data route and tcp.connect. The dependency at the end of that path is broken: the single ad replica ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (Deployment ad, 1 replica, container memory limit 450Mi / request 225Mi) has container ad terminated with exitCode 137 reason OOMKilled at finishedAt 01:38:26 and lastState OOMKilled startedAt 01:36:54 / finishedAt 01:37:24, restartCount 4, Ready condition False (ContainersNotReady since 01:38:27), and 23 Warning BackOff events for container ad with lastTimestamp 01:43:03; the Service Endpoints object ad lists only notReadyAddresses, so it has no routable backend. Chaos-mesh evidence names the injector: Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress (namespace chaos-mesh, uid 1bc9510a-6509-44a1-9438-44a7c5130cee) spawned memory-stress StressChaos objects about every minute from 01:34:15 to 01:42:00, and those objects logged 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' — the same container that OOMKilled — then Recovered it about 55 seconds later. The ad container's newest readable log line is 01:34:15, the instant of the first stress application, and ad's span rate collapsed from ~1.74/s at 01:39 to 0 from 01:45. The conclusion is partial because the chaos Schedule/StressChaos spec (stress size, duration, selector) could not be read with the available tools and Jaeger returned no traces, so the mechanism from injected memory stress to OOMKill, and the exact frontend-to-ad call edge, rest on timing, event messages and the frontend's own span operation names rather than a metric or trace chain.

claims.text: Frontend span traffic stayed roughly steady at ~39-46 spans/s through the window while its ERROR-status span rate rose from 0 (points at 01:11-01:35) to 1.359/s at 01:37, peaked at 3.61/s at 01:43, and was still 1.65/s at 01:47; status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET is unset, not success.

At 01:40 the frontend's ERROR-status spans were on span_name GET, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, executing api route (pages) /api/data, GET /api/data and tcp.connect (0.837/s each for the first four, 0.0148/s for tcp.connect), while its CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem and CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error rates were 0.
The ad service's span rate fell from ~1.74/s at 01:39 to 1.026/s at 01:41, 0.141/s at 01:43 and 0/s at 01:45, 01:47 and 01:49, while its ERROR-status rate stayed 0 for the whole series.

Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (owner ReplicaSet ad-554b849958, started 2026-11-17T00:57:46Z, restartCount 4) has container ad in state terminated with exitCode 137 reason OOMKilled, finishedAt 2026-11-17T01:38:26Z, and lastState terminated exitCode 137 OOMKilled startedAt 01:36:54Z finishedAt 01:37:24Z; the pod's Ready condition is False with reason ContainersNotReady since 2026-11-17T01:38:27Z.

Kubernetes events for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 in namespace otel-demo record 6x 'Created container: ad' / 'Started container ad' at 01:39:55 and 23x Warning 'Back-off restarting failed container ad in pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5' with lastTimestamp 2026-11-17T01:43:03Z.

The Endpoints object ad in namespace otel-demo has no ready addresses: its only subset contains notReadyAddresses [{ip 100.96.2.230, nodeName i-0d81a0f472ebdc704, targetRef Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5}] with port tcp-service 8080, so the Service has no routable backend.

Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo runs 1 replica with container ad image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, resources limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi and requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi; at query time its status showed replicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1 and no ready/available replica count.

Chaos-mesh StressChaos events in namespace chaos-mesh name objects otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq (01:34:15), -7n9mk (01:35:15), -8b272 (01:36:15), -sh425 (01:37:15), -w8tqb (applied 01:38:16), -w98sl (01:41:05), each with the message 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' and a later 'Successfully recover chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' about 55 seconds after application (e.g. 01:34:15 -> 01:35:10, 01:41:05 -> 01:42:00).

Chaos-mesh Schedule events for object otel-demo-ad-memory-stress (involvedObject.uid 1bc9510a-6509-44a1-9438-44a7c5130cee, namespace chaos-mesh) show 'Create new object: otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-<suffix>' at 01:34:15, 01:35:15, 01:36:15, 01:37:15, 01:38:15, 01:39:15, 01:41:05 and 01:42:00, plus 'Forbid spawning new job because: otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-w4ct8 is still running' at 01:40:15 and similar Forbid events at 01:41:15, 01:42:00, 01:42:15 and 01:42:28.

The newest ad container log line still readable for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 in the 01:30:00-01:50:00 read window is timestamped 2026-11-17T01:34:15.132997Z ('Targeted ad request received for [assembly]'); the stream ends there and the previous container instance's logs were unavailable (HTTP 400 previous terminated container not found).

At 01:45 the only services with a non-zero ERROR-status span rate were frontend (3.333/s), frontend-proxy (1.656/s) and fraud-detection (0.0037/s); accounting, payment, recommendation and ad were 0/s.

At the time of query the other otel-demo workloads were healthy: every other pod in namespace otel-demo reported Ready=True with restartCount 0 (including frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx, container frontend running since 00:57:48Z with 0 restarts), and only the ad container was unready/terminated.

Ad itself never reported error status: its ERROR-status span rate was 0/s across the whole observed series while its span rate dropped to 0/s, so the observed failure mode is ad becoming unreachable/idle rather than ad returning application error statuses.

Not every scheduled experiment applied: otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-9ncrx (01:42:00) and -w4ct8 (01:39:15) repeatedly logged Warning 'Failed to apply chaos: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = no running task found: task ... not found', and -w8tqb logged the same failure many times before one 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' at 01:38:16, so the chaos applications were partly erroring.

The memory stress injected into container ad of pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 by the otel-demo-ad-memory-stress StressChaos objects is what drove that container past its 450Mi memory limit and produced the OOMKilled exit-137 terminations (finishedAt 01:37:24 and 01:38:26), which then left the pod not Ready and the ad Service with only notReadyAddresses. The supporting evidence is timing and the target identity written in the event messages; no memory-usage metric or readable StressChaos spec was obtained to prove the mechanism.

The frontend request errors are a consequence of the ad Service having no ready endpoint: frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans carry ERROR status and frontend also emits tcp.connect ERROR spans, consistent with connection-level failure to ad (no ready endpoint), which then surfaces on the /api/data route and gets counted by the RequestErrorRate signal for frontend; an explicit trace parent-child chain could not be verified because Jaeger returned no spans for frontend in the window.

frontend-proxy's own error spans (1.656/s at 01:45 on span_name ingress and 'router frontend egress') are the proxy-facing reflection of frontend failures rather than an independent fault; no parent references were available to confirm that edge.

Rejected: a frontend pod crash or restart caused the alert. The frontend container has restartCount 0 and has been running since 00:57:48Z with Ready=True, yet its client spans to AdService are the ones failing.

Rejected: another otel-demo dependency besides ad was failing at the same time. At 01:45 error-span rates were 0/s for accounting, payment, recommendation and ad (only frontend, frontend-proxy and a negligible 0.0037/s at fraud-detection were non-zero), and every other otel-demo pod was Ready with 0 restarts.

Rejected: the ad workload was rolled out or rescheduled to a new pod. It is the same pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 created at 00:57:46Z (owner ReplicaSet ad-554b849958) with restartCount 4; the 6 'Created container: ad'/'Started container ad' events are container restarts inside that pod, not new pod creation.

Read the chaos-mesh objects that could not be read here: the Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and one of its StressChaos instances (e.g. otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq / -w98sl) in namespace chaos-mesh, to confirm the declared memory stress size, duration, mode and target selector, and identify who created the Schedule.

gaps: The chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and its StressChaos instances could not be read as objects with the available query kinds, so the declared stress memory size, duration, mode and target selector, and the object's creation time/creator, are unverified; only event messages were available.

Jaeger returned no traces for service frontend in 2026-11-17T01:30-01:45 (status no_data) and none for error=true in 01:34-01:50 (status no_data); therefore no trace-level parent/child edge from frontend's GetAds client span to the ad pod was verified, and the call chain is inferred only from span operation names on frontend.

frontend pod logs returned no lines at all for 01:34-01:50 (both the unfiltered read and the filtered read returned status no_data), so frontend application-level error text, for example the exact gRPC status returned by GetAds, is unknown.
rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count has no series for service_name frontend (get_label_values returned nothing, status no_data), so gRPC status codes at the frontend could not be read.

The ad container's previous-instance logs were unavailable (HTTP 400: previous terminated container ad not found), and the current stream ends at 01:34:15, so no ad log lines exist here for the OOMKills at 01:37:24 / 01:38:26; the last container's stdout before the kill is unknown.

Whether the frontend error rate recovered cannot be established: a 2m rate at 01:46 returns 0 for both ad and frontend, and the 5m series returns 0 at 01:49 while total span rate also drops to 0, which is consistent with a collection gap rather than a proven recovery, and the ad pod was still unready at 01:54.
The RequestErrorRate alerting rule was not found by list_prometheus_rules (rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned status no_data), so the alert's exact PromQL expression and threshold are unknown.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so the deployment/rollout history of the memory limit or of the chaos Schedule cannot be checked.
No pod memory-usage series were obtained, so the memory-consumption curve of the ad container before its OOMKills is unknown.
next_steps: Fetch the Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and one StressChaos instance in namespace chaos-mesh with a tool that can read chaos-mesh custom resources, and record the declared stressor size, duration, mode and selector.
Determine whether the recurring ad memory-stress experiment was intentional test load; if not, suspend or delete the Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress (advisory only, not executed here).

If the experiment is intended, compare its declared memory stress with the ad container's 450Mi limit / 225Mi request and consider raising the limit or lowering the stressor so the demo ad replica survives.

Confirm alert recovery by re-checking frontend ERROR-span rate and ad Service ready endpoints after the ad container stops OOMKilling, and correlate with kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason once such series exist for this pod.
